## 📋 Pull Request Summary

### 1. Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] ♻️ Code refactor (`refactor`)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (`docs`)
- [ ] 🧪 Testing improvement (`test`)
- [ ] 🔧 Build / CI / Tooling (`chore`)

---

### 2. Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the changes made in this PR.

---

### 3. Motivation & Context
Why is this change required? What issue does it solve?

---

### 4. Engineering Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the repository's clean architecture and SOLID conventions.
- [ ] Strict type hints (`typing` / Pydantic) are applied and verified.
- [ ] Automated tests have been added or updated to cover all new logic.
- [ ] All automated tests pass (`pytest` is 100% green).
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, API tokens, or `.env` files are included.
- [ ] No untracked binary files exceeding 5MB are included (Git LFS configured).
- [ ] Branch naming follows the standard: `feature/`, `bugfix/`, `hotfix/`, etc.

---

### 5. Verification & Test Evidence
Include output of `pytest` or reproduction command:
```bash
pytest -v
```

---

### 6. Reviewer Sign-off
- [ ] Architecture review approved
- [ ] Code quality & test coverage approved
